# Mixx-DJ-MCP — Full LLM Context

## What Is Mixx-DJ-MCP?

Mixx-DJ-MCP is a FastMCP 3.4+ server that bridges LLM agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, opencode) to Mixxx — the leading open-source DJ software. It exposes Mixxx's built-in OSC protocol as structured MCP tools, enabling natural-language DJ control.

The server uses the **industrial portmanteau pattern**: related operations are grouped into a single tool with an `operation` enum discriminator. This keeps the tool surface clean while providing full control over Mixxx's deck, library, effects, and mixer subsystems.

## Architecture Overview

```
Agent (Claude/Cursor/opencode)
    │ MCP stdio or HTTP
    ▼
mixx-dj-mcp (FastMCP 3.4+)
    │
    ├── mixx_deck(deck, operation, ...)       # Transport, cue, loop, sync, hot cues
    ├── mixx_library(operation, ...)           # Search, browse, track info
    ├── mixx_effects(chain, operation, ...)    # Chain management, effect params
    └── mixx_mixer(channel, operation, ...)    # Crossfader, EQ, volume, gain
    │
    ▼ OSC UDP (python-osc)
Mixxx (ports 11118/11119)
    ├── Deck 1-4 (play, stop, cue, loop, sync, hot cues, scratch, ...)
    ├── Mixer (crossfader, EQ, gain, volume, headphone)
    ├── Effects (chain, unit, parameter)
    └── Library (search, crate, playlist, track metadata)
```

## Tool Reference

### mixx_deck

Full deck control for decks 1-4.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `play` | `deck` | Start playback |
| `stop` | `deck` | Stop playback |
| `cue` | `deck` | Set/manage cue point |
| `cue_goto` | `deck` | Jump to cue point |
| `loop` | `deck`, `size` | Enable loop at specified beat size |
| `loop_roll` | `deck`, `size` | Roll loop (returns to position after release) |
| `sync` | `deck` | Sync to master deck |
| `sync_enable` | `deck`, `enabled` | Toggle sync lock |
| `hot_cue` | `deck`, `cue_num` | Activate/set hot cue (1-4) |
| `hot_cue_clear` | `deck`, `cue_num` | Clear hot cue |
| `scratch` | `deck`, `position` | Scratch to position (-1.0 to 1.0) |
| `seek` | `deck`, `position` | Seek to track position (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `quantize` | `deck`, `enabled` | Toggle beat quantization |
| `keylock` | `deck`, `enabled` | Toggle keylock (preserve pitch) |
| `load_track` | `deck`, `track_location` | Load track from library |
| `eject` | `deck` | Eject (unload) track |
| `beatjump` | `deck`, `beats` | Jump forward/backward by beats (negative = back) |
| `beatloop` | `deck`, `beats` | Set beat loop of specified length |
| `rate` | `deck`, `rate` | Set playback speed rate |
| `rate_reset` | `deck` | Reset rate to 0% |
| `pregain` | `deck`, `gain` | Set pregain in dB |
| `filter_high` | `deck`, `value` | Set high shelf filter (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `filter_mid` | `deck`, `value` | Set mid peak filter (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `filter_low` | `deck`, `value` | Set low shelf filter (0.0 to 1.0) |

**Return format:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Started playback on Deck 1",
  "data": {
    "deck": 1,
    "operation": "play",
    "state": "playing"
  }
}
```

### mixx_library

Library search and navigation.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `search` | `query`, `limit` | Full-text search across library |
| `browse_crate` | `crate_name`, `limit` | List tracks in a crate |
| `browse_playlist` | `playlist_name`, `limit` | List tracks in a playlist |
| `track_info` | `track_location` | Get detailed track metadata |
| `list_crates` | — | List all crates |
| `list_playlists` | — | List all playlists |
| `search_bpm` | `min_bpm`, `max_bpm`, `limit` | Filter by BPM range |
| `search_genre` | `genre`, `limit` | Filter by genre |
| `search_key` | `key`, `limit` | Filter by musical key |

**Return format:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Found 12 tracks matching 'tech house'",
  "data": {
    "query": "tech house",
    "count": 12,
    "results": [
      {"title": "...", "artist": "...", "bpm": 128, "key": "7A", "location": "...", "duration": 360}
    ]
  }
}
```

### mixx_effects

Effect chain management and parameter control.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `chain_enable` | `chain`, `enabled` | Enable/disable effect chain |
| `chain_select` | `chain`, `unit_type` | Select effect unit type for chain |
| `chain_focus` | `chain` | Focus on this chain |
| `effect_enable` | `chain`, `effect`, `enabled` | Enable/disable individual effect |
| `effect_param` | `chain`, `effect`, `param`, `value` | Set effect parameter (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `quick_effect` | `chain`, `effect` | Quick-activate effect with defaults |
| `clear_chain` | `chain` | Clear all effects from chain |
| `list_chains` | — | List available effect chains and their status |

### mixx_mixer

Mixer channel control.

**Operations:**

| Operation | Params | Description |
|-----------|--------|-------------|
| `crossfader` | `position` | Set crossfader position (-1.0 to 1.0) |
| `crossfader_curve` | `curve` | Set crossfader curve (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `volume` | `channel`, `volume` | Set channel volume (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `gain` | `channel`, `gain` | Set channel gain in dB |
| `balance` | `channel`, `balance` | Set channel balance (-1.0 to 1.0) |
| `headphone` | `channel`, `enabled` | Toggle headphone cue |
| `talkover` | `channel`, `enabled` | Toggle talkover (mic) |
| `orientation` | `channel`, `orientation` | Set channel orientation (left/center/right) |
| `eq_high` | `channel`, `value` | Set high EQ band (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `eq_mid` | `channel`, `value` | Set mid EQ band (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `eq_low` | `channel`, `value` | Set low EQ band (0.0 to 1.0) |
| `eq_reset` | `channel` | Reset all EQ bands to neutral |

## Mixxx OSC Address Reference

Mixxx exposes OSC endpoints under `/controller` namespace. Key address patterns:

### Deck Control (`/deck/[1-4]/...`)

| Address | Type | Values | Description |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|
| `/deck/[1-4]/play` | bool | 0/1 | Play/pause |
| `/deck/[1-4]/play_indicator` | float | 0/1 | Play state indicator |
| `/deck/[1-4]/cue_default` | bool | 0/1 | Set/jump to cue |
| `/deck/[1-4]/cue_goto` | bool | 0/1 | Jump to cue |
| `/deck/[1-4]/cue_set` | bool | 0/1 | Set cue point |
| `/deck/[1-4]/loop_enabled` | bool | 0/1 | Loop on/off |
| `/deck/[1-4]/beatloop_[4,8,16,32]` | bool | 0/1 | Beat loop toggle |
| `/deck/[1-4]/beatjump_[1,2,4,8,16]_forward` | bool | 0/1 | Beat jump forward |
| `/deck/[1-4]/beatjump_[1,2,4,8,16]_backward` | bool | 0/1 | Beat jump backward |
| `/deck/[1-4]/sync_enabled` | bool | 0/1 | Sync lock toggle |
| `/deck/[1-4]/sync_mode` | float | 0-4 | Sync mode |
| `/deck/[1-4]/hotcue_[1-4]_activated` | bool | 0/1 | Hot cue activate |
| `/deck/[1-4]/hotcue_[1-4]_set` | bool | 0/1 | Hot cue set |
| `/deck/[1-4]/hotcue_[1-4]_clear` | bool | 0/1 | Hot cue clear |
| `/deck/[1-4]/rate` | float | -1.0 to 1.0 | Playback rate |
| `/deck/[1-4]/rate_perm_up` | bool | 0/1 | Rate increase |
| `/deck/[1-4]/rate_perm_down` | bool | 0/1 | Rate decrease |
| `/deck/[1-4]/pregain` | float | 0.0 to 4.0 | Pregain (linear) |
| `/deck/[1-4]/filterHigh` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | High shelf filter |
| `/deck/[1-4]/filterMid` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Mid peak filter |
| `/deck/[1-4]/filterLow` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Low shelf filter |
| `/deck/[1-4]/quantize` | bool | 0/1 | Quantize on/off |
| `/deck/[1-4]/keylock` | bool | 0/1 | Keylock on/off |
| `/deck/[1-4]/LoadTrack` | string | path | Load track from path |
| `/deck/[1-4]/eject` | bool | 0/1 | Eject track |
| `/deck/[1-4]/scratch` | float | -1.0 to 1.0 | Scratch position |

### Mixer (`/mixer/...`)

| Address | Type | Values | Description |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|
| `/mixer/crossfader` | float | -1.0 to 1.0 | Crossfader position |
| `/mixer/crossfader_curve` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Crossfader curve |
| `/mixer/volume/[1-4]` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Channel volume |
| `/mixer/pregain/[1-4]` | float | 0.0 to 4.0 | Channel pregain |
| `/mixer/balance/[1-4]` | float | -1.0 to 1.0 | Channel balance |
| `/mixer/headVolume/[1-4]` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Headphone volume |
| `/mixer/pfl/[1-4]` | bool | 0/1 | Headphone cue (PFL) |
| `/mixer/talkover/[1-4]` | bool | 0/1 | Talkover enable |
| `/mixer/orientation/[1-4]` | int | 0/1/2 | Orientation (L/C/R) |
| `/mixer/equalizer/[1-4]/[0-2]` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | EQ band (0=low, 1=mid, 2=high) |

### Effects (`/effects/...`)

| Address | Type | Values | Description |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|
| `/effects/chain/[1-4]/enabled` | bool | 0/1 | Chain enable |
| `/effects/chain/[1-4]/mix` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Chain wet/dry mix |
| `/effects/chain/[1-4]/super` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Super knob |
| `/effects/chain/[1-4]/effect/[1-4]/enabled` | bool | 0/1 | Effect enable |
| `/effects/chain/[1-4]/effect/[1-4]/param/[1-4]` | float | 0.0 to 1.0 | Effect parameter |

### Library

| Address | Type | Values | Description |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|
| `/Library/LoadTrackIntoDeck/[1-4]` | string | path | Load track into deck |

## REST API

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/health` | GET | Server health + Mixxx status |
| `/api/v1/diagnostics` | GET | Full diagnostics (tools, OSC, system) |
| `/api/skills` | GET | List available skills |
| `/api/skills/{name}` | GET | Get skill content |

## Configuration

| Env Var | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `MIXX_MCP_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Server bind address |
| `MIXX_MCP_PORT` | 11116 | Server HTTP port |
| `MIXX_OSC_OUT_PORT` | 11118 | OSC output (Mixxx feedback) |
| `MIXX_OSC_IN_PORT` | 11119 | OSC input (Mixxx commands) |
| `MIXX_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Mixxx host address |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | info | Logging level |
| `MIXX_TAURI` | 0 | Set to 1 when launched from Tauri wrapper |

## Setup Guide

### 1. Mixxx OSC Configuration

1. Open Mixxx → Preferences
2. Navigate to MIDI/OSC section
3. Check **Enable OSC**
4. Set **Output port**: `11118`
5. Set **Input port**: `11119`
6. Set **Send to**: `127.0.0.1`
7. Click Apply and restart Mixxx

### 2. Start the MCP Server

```bash
# stdio (for Claude Desktop)
uv run python -m mixx_dj_mcp.server

# HTTP (for webapp + multi-client)
uv run uvicorn mixx_dj_mcp.server:app --port 11116 --reload
```

### 3. Verify

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:11116/api/health
```

Returns:
```json
{"status": "ok", "server": "mixx-dj-mcp", "version": "0.1.0", "mixx_connected": true}
```

## Development Guide

### Project Structure

```
mixx-dj-mcp/
├── src/
│   └── mixx_dj_mcp/
│       ├── __init__.py
│       ├── server.py          # FastMCP app + tool registration
│       ├── config.py          # Configuration management
│       ├── transport.py       # Dual transport (stdio/HTTP)
│       ├── osc/
│       │   ├── __init__.py
│       │   ├── bridge.py      # OSC UDP client
│       │   └── addresses.py   # OSC address constants
│       ├── tools/
│       │   ├── __init__.py    # Portmanteau imports
│       │   ├── deck.py
│       │   ├── library.py
│       │   ├── effects.py
│       │   └── mixer.py
│       ├── models/
│       │   ├── __init__.py
│       │   └── schemas.py
│       └── skills/
│           └── mixx-dj/
│               └── SKILL.md
├── tests/
│   ├── test_deck.py
│   ├── test_library.py
│   ├── test_effects.py
│   └── test_mixer.py
├── web_sota/                  # React webapp
├── native/                    # Tauri NSIS build
├── bridge/
│   └── README.md              # OSC setup guide
├── scripts/
│   └── cua-smoke.py           # CUA-NSIS smoke test
├── .env.example
├── start.ps1
├── start.bat
├── pyproject.toml
├── justfile

├── llms-full.txt
```

### just recipes

```bash
just lint        # ruff check + format
just test        # pytest
just serve       # uvicorn dev server
just build-native  # Tauri NSIS build
just cua-nsis-test # CUA smoke test
just e2e         # Playwright E2E
```

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely Cause | Solution |
|---------|-------------|----------|
| `OSCError: [Errno 10061]` | Mixxx not running or OSC not enabled | Start Mixxx, verify OSC preferences |
| Commands work then stop | Mixxx OSC port changed | Restart Mixxx, verify ports match .env |
| `Connection refused` on 11118/11119 | Port conflict | Check `netstat -ano` for other apps on these ports |
| Library search returns empty | Mixxx library not indexed | Open Mixxx, ensure tracks are in library |
| Slow response | UDP packet loss | Enable OSC feedback polling for confirmation |
| Tools not showing in client | FastMCP import issue | Verify `__init__.py` imports all tool modules |
| Webapp shows "Backend offline" | Backend not running or wrong port | Run `uv run uvicorn ... --port 11116`, check health endpoint |
